entries.title: Daniel 10:1
segments: ¶In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar. The message [was] true, but the appointed time [was] long; and he understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.

entries.title: Daniel 10:2
segments: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three full weeks.

entries.title: Daniel 10:3
segments: I ate no pleasant food, no meat or wine came into my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

entries.title: Daniel 10:4
segments: Now on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, that [is], the Tigris,

entries.title: Daniel 10:5
segments: I lifted my eyes and looked, and behold, a certain man clothed in linen, whose waist [was] girded with gold of Uphaz!

entries.title: Daniel 10:6
segments: His body [was] like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like torches of fire, his arms and feet like burnished bronze in color, and the sound of his words like the voice of a multitude.

entries.title: Daniel 10:7
segments: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see the vision; but a great terror fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

entries.title: Daniel 10:8
segments: Therefore I was left alone when I saw this great vision, and no strength remained in me; for my vigor was turned to frailty in me, and I retained no strength.

entries.title: Daniel 10:9
segments: Yet I heard the sound of his words; and while I heard the sound of his words I was in a deep sleep on my face, with my face to the ground.

entries.title: Daniel 10:10
segments: ¶Suddenly, a hand touched me, which made me tremble on my knees and [on] the palms of my hands.

entries.title: Daniel 10:11
segments: And he said to me, "O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have now been sent to you." While he was speaking this word to me, I stood trembling.

entries.title: Daniel 10:12
segments: Then he said to me, "Do not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard; and I have come because of your words.

entries.title: Daniel 10:13
segments: "But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; and behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I had been left alone there with the kings of Persia.

entries.title: Daniel 10:14
segments: "Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision [refers] to [many] days yet [to come]."

entries.title: Daniel 10:15
segments: When he had spoken such words to me, I turned my face toward the ground and became speechless.

entries.title: Daniel 10:16
segments: And suddenly, [one] having the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips; then I opened my mouth and spoke, saying to him who stood before me, "My lord, because of the vision my sorrows have overwhelmed me, and I have retained no strength.

entries.title: Daniel 10:17
segments: "For how can this servant of my lord talk with you, my lord? As for me, no strength remains in me now, nor is any breath left in me."

entries.title: Daniel 10:18
segments: Then again, [the one] having the likeness of a man touched me and strengthened me.

entries.title: Daniel 10:19
segments: And he said, "O man greatly beloved, fear not! Peace [be] to you; be strong, yes, be strong!" So when he spoke to me I was strengthened, and said, "Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me."

entries.title: Daniel 10:20
segments: Then he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? And now I must return to fight with the prince of Persia; and when I have gone forth, indeed the prince of Greece will come.

entries.title: Daniel 10:21
segments: "But I will tell you what is noted in the Scripture of Truth. (No one upholds me against these, except Michael your prince.
